title: Voz pasiva: consecuencias de la economía colonial

sections.content: A synthesis on economic consequences reaches for passive voice to keep money, prices and wealth as the grammatical subject — what happened to them matters more than naming an agent every time. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Cantidades históricamente inéditas de plata y oro fueron enviadas desde América hacia España.
items.english: Historically unprecedented quantities of silver and gold were sent from America to Spain.

items.spanish: Buena parte de la plata fue simplemente utilizada para pagar deudas de guerra.
items.english: Much of the silver was simply used to pay off war debts.

items.spanish: Los precios de bienes y servicios fueron empujados al alza durante generaciones.
items.english: The prices of goods and services were pushed upward for generations.

items.spanish: Los beneficios de esta economía fueron distribuidos de forma extremadamente desigual.
items.english: The benefits of this economy were distributed extremely unequally.

sections.content: A whole paragraph built from ser + participle sentences (fueron enviadas, fue utilizada, fueron empujados, fueron distribuidos) reads as a chain of consequences — each new passive sentence can pick up where the last one left off, which is exactly what a 'what did all this lead to?' synthesis needs.
